name: RAD140 cycle

lead: RAD140, also called testolone or vosilasarm, is an experimental oral selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). In bodybuilding and lifting forums, a RAD140 cycle means a bounded period of use aimed at more muscle and strength [1][2].

It was developed by Radius Health around 2010 and studied for muscle wasting, sarcopenia and osteoporosis; it is now being studied in androgen-receptor-positive breast cancer [1]. Its use for physique is outside any approved purpose, and doses used by recreational users have not been tested in trials [1].

paras: Users in forums describe taking it by mouth, often alongside lifting and diet, sometimes combined with other SARMs, and typically in defined blocks followed by breaks [3][4]. Specific regimens are not given here.

Reported effects include elevated liver enzymes, case reports of liver toxicity and a case of acute myocarditis, plus changes in hormone levels [2]. Studies found most products sold online as SARMs were mislabelled [2]. It is not approved by the FDA or EMA and is on WADA's prohibited list [1][2].

chain: More lean mass and strength, supporting a bigger physique
angle.text: Users take RAD140 in cycles in the hope of building more muscle than training alone. Trials of the compound were in patient groups rather than lifters, so the physique effects users describe are self-reported.

lead: A RAD140 cycle is the community term for a limited-duration course of RAD140 (testolone, vosilasarm), a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator taken orally. People in strength and physique communities use it to try to increase muscle mass and strength, which is the route to a bigger, leaner-looking physique [1][2].

RAD140 was developed around 2010 by Radius Health and first explored for cancer-related weight loss, sarcopenia and osteoporosis; those efforts were discontinued, and Ellipses Pharma is developing it for advanced AR-positive breast cancer [1]. It is not approved for any medical use [1].
Its use for physique is non-medical. T Nation forum members discuss having experimented with RAD140 and other SARMs [3] and stacking multiple SARMs without steroids [4].

paras: In forum usage, a cycle is a period of use followed by a break, borrowed from anabolic steroid culture. RAD140 is marketed by gray-market sellers for physique and performance purposes, and users often take amounts never tested in trials [1].

Early development targeted muscle wasting, sarcopenia and osteoporosis; current work is in AR-positive, ER-negative, HER2-negative breast cancer, including a small phase 1 study in postmenopausal women (2017 to 2020) and a later phase 1/2 trial [1]. SARMs as a class show less muscle gain than moderate testosterone doses according to a general reference, and no SARM was approved by the FDA or EMA as of 2023 [2].

Trial participants reported vomiting, dehydration, reduced appetite, weight loss, hormone changes and raised liver enzymes [1]. Case reports describe drug-induced liver injury from recreational SARM use, and one case of myocarditis linked to non-medical RAD140 use [1][2]. One study found most online SARM products were mislabelled [2]. SARMs have been prohibited by WADA since 2008 [2].

Human trials have been conducted in patients with advanced breast cancer rather than in healthy lifters; participants experienced the adverse events above [1]. No trials have tested the cycles used in physique communities.
